reader.requirement: ACCEPT identifier-2 FROM DATE must deliver YYMMDD (year of century, month, day; 25 December 1986 = 861225) as if from an unsigned six-digit integer item, stored by the MOVE rules.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses DATE YYYYMMDD / DAY YYYYDDD (accept-four-digit-year-2002, COBOL0815) and END-ACCEPT (end-accept-2002, COBOL0816) below 2002; the bare DATE / DAY / DAY-OF-WEEK / TIME forms pass through unchanged
the rows accept-four-digit-year-2002 and end-accept-2002 (introduced 2002) that the pass checks
DATE, DAY, DAY-OF-WEEK and TIME are reserved at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023 alike, so a user item of those names is refused (COBOL0901)

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|Construct in AcceptDisplayBinder.cs, AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs, BoundAccept.cs, AcceptSource.cs and MoveTable16.cs: the binder's ctx.Edition is only the diagnostic sink; the emitter, the conceptual-digit table and the runtime clock reads consult no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: at 2002 and later DATE YYYYMMDD exists too; bare DATE is the same six digits, and the YYYYMMDD phrase is refused at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f12_01 checks six digits and month/day ranges on the run day; the rule's own example date, year 00 with leading zeros, and edited, alphanumeric and 18-digit receivers are not exercised

probes.expected: 861225 (the GR7 example); high-order zero fill in a 9(18) receiver
year of century 00 keeps its zeros
the six-digit integer edited, and truncated on the right into X(3)

probes.printed: error COBOL0815: ACCEPT FROM DATE YYYYMMDD / DAY YYYYDDD requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: refused: §1985:VI.6.5.2 format 2 lists bare DATE / DAY / DAY-OF-WEEK / TIME only

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR7  (6.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7 ["would be expressed as 861225"]

reader.notes: AcceptSource.Date computes Year mod 100 * 10000 + Month * 100 + Day from the run unit's clock and the conceptual item is six digits (AcceptKinds.ConceptualDigits). The pinned 1986-12-25 run prints the rule's own example, 861225; the witness g85_f12_01 MATCHES at 85.

refuter.evidence: AcceptSource.Date = Year%100*10000+Month*100+Day; racc1.cob at 85 pinned 1986-12-25: BZ 9(6)=861225, NE4 9(3)/9(3)=861/225, 9(4) COMP=1225 (left truncation), 999PPP=861 thousands; DATE YYYYMMDD refused at 85 (rx14 COBOL0815) and the GnuCOBOL YYYYMMDD/CENTURY-DATE sources refused (COBOL0817). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR7 ["would be expressed as 861225"].
